details: For every finite binary class, the stronger counting bound $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\geq2^{\mathrm{VC}^{*}(\mathcal H)}-2$ holds. In particular $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{VC}^{*}(\mathcal H)-1$.
proof: If d concepts are shattered in the dual, the $2^d$ label patterns on them are realized by distinct coordinates. All patterns except the all-zero and all-one patterns are nonconstant on those concepts, hence their coordinates are effective. Thus $\mathrm E\geq2^d-2$. Since $2^d-2\geq d-1$ for every d, this gives the recorded affine bound.
name: Effective Range / Dual VC Dimension
witness_verification: For the family #classes/full_cube with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
